content.short: Unspins QOOB is a 3D art collection on Cardano designed for VR, AR, and metaverse-ready experiences.
content.description: Unspins QOOB is a Cardano 3D art collection built with VR, AR, and metaverse use in mind. The project positions its artwork as more than static collectible imagery by emphasizing readiness for immersive and interactive digital environments. Its core appeal is the combination of Cardano-native ownership with art designed to travel into virtual and augmented experiences.
